name: reel-ad-blocker
description: Browser extension: mark a Facebook reel as an ad once, block look-alikes from then on.

scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/reel-ad-blocker-*.zip && zip -r -X -D dist/reel-ad-blocker-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json icons/*.png src manage.html manage.css manage.js
